@R1Z.PV_OWNI_Allocation.success : ∀ {S X E : Type}
  (primitive : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Request → S → R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Outcome E (Option ℕ) × S)
  (w : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.State S X) (p owner capacity : ℕ) (s : S),
  primitive { size := capacity * 24, alignment := 8 } w.allocator = (R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Outcome.ok (some p), s) →
    R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.allocate primitive { size := capacity * 24, alignment := 8 } owner w =
      { outcome := R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Outcome.ok (some (R1Z.PV_OWNI_EmptyVec.token w.memory p)),
        world :=
          { memory := R1Z.PV_OWNI_EmptyVec.initialized w.memory p owner capacity, allocator := s, extra := w.extra },
        calls := [(w, R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Event.allocate (capacity * 24) 8)] }

@R1Z.PV_OWNI_DensePrune.boolean_weight : ∀ {K : Type} [inst : Field K] {I : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  (s b : I → Bool), R1Z.PV_OWNI_DensePrune.weight (fun i => if s i = true then 1 else 0) b = if b = s then 1 else 0

  [inst_2 : Fintype J] [inst_3 : DecidableEq I] [inst_4 : DecidableEq J] (p : I → K) (suffix : J → Bool)
  (column : (I → Bool) → (J → Bool) → K),

      ∑ b,
        R1Z.PV_OWNI_DensePrune.weight p a *
            R1Z.PV_OWNI_DensePrune.weight (fun j => if suffix j = true then 1 else 0) b *
          column a b =
    ∑ a, R1Z.PV_OWNI_DensePrune.weight p a * column a suffix

  (primitive : ℕ → R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Request → S → R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Outcome E Unit × S)
  (w : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.State S X) (t : R1Z.PV_OWN_Heap.Token) (c : R1Z.PV_OWN_Heap.Cell),
  0 < c.size →
    R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.dropVecPod primitive t c w =
      { outcome := (primitive t.address { size := c.size, alignment := c.alignment } w.allocator).1,
        world :=
          { memory := R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.retire t c w.memory,
            allocator := (primitive t.address { size := c.size, alignment := c.alignment } w.allocator).2,
            extra := w.extra },
        calls := [(w, R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Event.deallocate t.address c.size c.alignment)] }

  (primitive : ℕ → R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Request → S → R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Outcome E Unit × S)
  (w : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.State S X) (t : R1Z.PV_OWN_Heap.Token) (c : R1Z.PV_OWN_Heap.Cell),
  0 < c.size →
    (R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.dropVecPod primitive t c w).world.memory.heap t.address =

theorem R1Z.PV_OWNI_Drop.backing : ∀ {S X E : Type}
  (primitive : ℕ → R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Request → S → R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Outcome E Unit × S)
  (w : R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.State S X) (t : R1Z.PV_OWN_Heap.Token) (c : R1Z.PV_OWN_Heap.Cell),
  0 < c.size →
    R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.dropVecPod primitive t c w =
      { outcome := (primitive t.address { size := c.size, alignment := c.alignment } w.allocator).1,
        world :=
          { memory := R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.retire t c w.memory,
            allocator := (primitive t.address { size := c.size, alignment := c.alignment } w.allocator).2,
            extra := w.extra },
        calls := [(w, R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Event.deallocate t.address c.size c.alignment)] } :=
fun {S X E} primitive w t c positive =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          _a w =
            { outcome := (primitive t.address { size := c.size, alignment := c.alignment } w.allocator).1,
              world :=
                { memory := R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.retire t c w.memory,
                  allocator := (primitive t.address { size := c.size, alignment := c.alignment } w.allocator).2,
                  extra := w.extra },
              calls := [(w, R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.Event.deallocate t.address c.size c.alignment)] })
        (R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.dropVecPod.eq_1 primitive t c)))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            _a w =
              { outcome := (primitive t.address { size := c.size, alignment := c.alignment } w.allocator).1,
                world :=
                  { memory := R1Z.PV_OWN_Operations.retire t c w.memory,
                    allocator := (primitive t.address { size := c.size, alignment := c.alignment } w.allocator).2,
